name: Sanjay Maple
original_name: サンジャイ・メイプル
source:
The commander of the Imperial Army's First Battalion. [url=/c156180]Duke Brown[/url]'s prestige kinda overshadows him, but he's a sincerely stand-up dude.
...Okay, hang on. Is it just me, or does the Empire have a lot of party-poopers?

[From Digital Artwork book]
